scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: At the end of July, the long-awaited lab trip day has arrived. The presentation venue for the M1GP, held at a seaside resort hotel, is filled with excitement from the lab members.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: It’s finally Megumi-chan’s presentation… the travel SNS app we built together. I wonder if she’s nervous.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: We stayed up late every day fixing bugs together... I was truly amazed by how much she grew.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: And today... after the BBQ, I’ve made up my mind. I’m going to confess my feelings to Megumi-chan. No more hesitation, no matter the result.

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: Now then, let’s have the presentation from {{playerName}} and Megumi.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes! We developed 'TravelConnect', a travel SNS app exclusively for our lab members!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan is doing her best. But I can tell she’s a bit nervous...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: With this app, you can share travel photos, recommend spots, and even create travel plans with everyone!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Megumi’s presentation was earnest, though her nervousness showed a little. The audience watched over her warmly.

scenarios.speaker: Momo
scenarios.text: That’s a pretty solid app! I can tell you guys put a lot into it~

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you so much♪ We faced a lot of issues during development, but {{playerName}}-senpai supported me and helped me relearn everything from the basics!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan... she mentioned me. But truly, the one who worked the hardest was her.

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: Great work. Now, I’ll announce the results of this year’s M1GP...

scenarios.speaker: Professor
scenarios.text: This year’s M1GP winners are... the pair Tanaka and Sato. The pair {{playerName}} and Megumi came in third place.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Applause filled the room, but Megumi’s expression turned a little somber.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: I see... We didn’t win, did we...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan, even third place is an amazing result! You really gave it your all!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai... thank you. But... our promised trip...

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: She’s thinking about the promised trip... But for me, the result doesn’t matter.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: After the M1GP presentation, the traditional evening BBQ party began. A pleasant ocean breeze blew as lab members celebrated everyone’s hard work.

scenarios.speaker: IkeN
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan, third place is still awesome! You were just a programming beginner when you joined, and now look how far you've come!

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you so much♪ At first, I really didn’t understand anything... But {{playerName}}-senpai taught me everything so kindly.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: I remember Megumi-chan from the beginning... I was so nervous to even talk to her back then, but now being together like this feels so natural.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: By the way, {{playerName}}-senpai, do you remember our first conversation? I gave you a souvenir—Yuba manju.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Of course I remember. Ever since then, your kindness has always comforted me.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Back then, I thought you were someone so far away... But now, we can share our emotions together like this.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: She feels the same way... This is my chance. I’ll be brave.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan... if it’s okay, could I have a moment with just the two of us later?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Eh... yes! Of course. Where should we talk?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: How about a walk by the beach? There’s something I want to tell you.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: While the BBQ party continued, {{playerName}} and Megumi quietly walked down to the beach. Moonlight shimmered on the waves, with the gentle sound of the tide in the background.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Though she said nothing, Megumi seemed to understand why she’d been called out—her face was slightly tense with anticipation.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}-senpai... what did you want to talk about?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Alright, time to be honest like a man!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Please enter your confession line

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: You told Megumi your feelings...
